description:
Project: KV cache compaction improvements (Serving Runtime Performance: Kernel + Scheduling).

Problem / motivation:
Redwood’s serving runtime uses GPU memory heavily for KV cache. Under bursty workloads and mixed sequence-length distributions, allocations and frees can fragment the KV cache arena/pool. Fragmentation increases allocator overhead, can force suboptimal placement/evictions, and can cause burst tail-latency spikes (p95/p99) when the runtime hits memory-pressure and performs expensive slow-paths (e.g., emergency eviction, re-allocations, or partial stalls). Some customers observe latency “sawtoothing” during traffic bursts and occasional decode-time jitter tied to KV cache churn.

Goals:
- Reduce GPU memory fragmentation for KV cache over long-running processes.
- Reduce burst tail latencies (p95/p99) and variance, especially during mixed prefill/decode and burst traffic.
- Add a principled compaction + eviction strategy with clear policy knobs.
- Improve observability: fragmentation metrics, memory-pressure signals, and compaction cost accounting.
- Provide safe rollout controls (feature flag/config) and regression tests (perf + correctness).

Non-goals:
- Redesign the entire caching subsystem (prefix cache semantics remain unchanged).
- Introduce model-quality changes (no changes to outputs).
- Replace the GPU allocator globally (scope is KV cache allocation/management; any general allocator work must be justified by impact).

Scope / workstreams:
1) Instrumentation & diagnostics
- Add runtime metrics: fragmentation ratio, largest-free-block, allocation failure rate, compaction bytes moved, compaction time, eviction counts by reason.
- Add tracing spans for compaction/eviction decision points.
- Extend perf canary scenarios to include long-running, bursty mixed-length workloads.

2) Compaction strategy
- Define compaction triggers (threshold-based + hysteresis): e.g., fragmentation > X%, allocation failure near-miss, or memory-pressure high-watermark.
- Implement compaction algorithm for KV blocks/pages (e.g., moving live KV segments to coalesce free space), with bounded per-iteration work.
- Ensure correctness and concurrency safety with in-flight decode and scheduler interactions.

3) Eviction strategy
- Add policy-driven eviction when compaction can’t satisfy allocations quickly enough.
- Integrate with scheduler to prefer evicting low-priority or low-reuse candidates; support “graceful degradation” modes under pressure.

4) Scheduling integration
- Coordinate compaction work with scheduler to avoid synchronized stalls (e.g., budgeted background compaction, scheduling-aware windows, and backpressure integration).

5) Validation & rollout
- Benchmarks: microbench for allocator/compaction cost; macrobench for end-to-end latency under load.
- Guardrails: feature flags, staged rollout (staging → canary → 5% prod → 25% → 100%), auto-disable on regression.
- Documentation updates: standards, runbooks, known issues, and release notes.

Stakeholders / teams:
- Primary engineering: Serving Runtime (VP Mateo Alvarez), Runtime Scheduling (EM Sofia Ivanova), Runtime Kernels (EM Hiro Tanaka).
- Key contributors: Samir Qureshi (memory/KV), Omar El-Sayed (KV + tail latency), Noah Patel (runtime architecture/correctness), Marcus Reed/Lena Fischer (scheduler + perf).
- SRE/Infra partners: Sean Gallagher, Rafael Mendes, Aisha Bello (dashboards/alerts), Tomáš Novák (incident learnings).
- Benchmarking support: Claire Dubois, Rina Kobayashi.
- Product interface/priority alignment: Henry Cho (PM, perf transparency/customer messaging).

Timeline (hypothetical):
- Phase 0 (late Jan–Feb 2026): incident-driven triage, instrumentation, initial design/ADR.
- Phase 1 (Feb–Mar 2026): implement compaction v1 behind flag + perf canary coverage.
- Phase 2 (Mar–Apr 2026): eviction policy integration + scheduling-aware compaction budgeting.
- Phase 3 (Apr 2026): staged production rollout + LTS backport decision + documentation/runbooks finalized.

Deliverables:
- Design doc + ADR, implementation PRs, perf suite updates, new dashboards/alerts, runbook, release notes, and post-incident follow-up closure in Linear.

files.description: Primary design doc: fragmentation problem statement, allocator model, proposed compaction algorithm (data structures, concurrency), triggers, budgets, and rollout plan; links to Linear epic and benchmark plan.
ADR capturing the chosen approach (compaction + policy-based eviction) vs alternatives (bigger pool, periodic restart, global allocator swap), with trade-offs and decision date/owners.
Benchmark plan: synthetic workloads, long-run fragmentation tests, burst schedules, acceptance thresholds (p95/p99), and how results are stored/compared.
Profiling guide addendum: how to detect fragmentation, what counters to look at, Nsight/trace steps, and common failure modes.
Known issue page: symptoms, mitigations, config knobs, and links to runbooks/alerts; updated as compaction rolls out.
SRE runbook: what to do when memory pressure spikes (feature-flag toggles, rate-limits/load shedding, rollback steps, dashboards to consult).
Dashboards/alerts spec: panels for fragmentation ratio, compaction time, eviction rate, latency correlation; proposed alert thresholds and paging policy.
Incident review summary: timeline, customer impact, contributing factors (fragmentation + burst traffic), immediate mitigations, and follow-up actions tied to this project.
Update to performance standards: defines required memory/fragmentation metrics, perf gates for long-running tests, and regression budget policies.
Runtime release note draft: introduces compaction feature flag, config options, expected perf changes, and safe-rollback instructions.
Epic: “KV cache compaction improvements” (project umbrella). Includes goals/non-goals, milestones, and links to design doc/ADR.
Instrumentation: add fragmentation metrics + allocator slow-path counters; acceptance criteria includes dashboard readiness and sampling overhead limits.
Implement compaction v1 behind feature flag; defines compaction triggers and maximum per-step budget; includes testing + rollback plan.
Concurrency/correctness audit for moving KV blocks with in-flight decode; includes stress tests and race-check tooling.
Eviction policy work: define candidate scoring (age, reuse probability, request priority) and integrate with scheduler.
Scheduler integration: schedule-aware compaction windows + backpressure hooks; avoids synchronized stalls.
Perf suite: add long-running burst fragmentation scenario to benchmark-lab/perf-canary; sets pass/fail thresholds.
Canary rollout plan: staged enablement + auto-disable rules; required dashboards and alerts before 25% traffic.
Production guardrails: config validation, safe defaults, and “panic mode” behavior under allocator failure.
Backport decision for enterprise/LTS runtime branch; includes risk assessment and test requirements.
Documentation tasks: update runbooks/known issues/release notes once feature flag ships.
Post-incident follow-up closure: verify tail-latency improvement on affected regions; attach before/after graphs.
Allocator tuning: adjust KV block sizing / binning strategy to reduce fragmentation upstream of compaction.
Observability pack: add standard Prometheus metrics + exemplars; ensure consistent naming and cardinality limits.
Failure-mode testing: simulate near-OOM + burst traffic; confirm graceful eviction instead of request timeouts.
PR: add KV allocator fragmentation metrics (ratio, largest-free-block) and export to runtime metrics pipeline; includes unit tests and perf overhead check.
PR: introduce feature flag/config plumbing for compaction (disabled by default), including validation and dynamic reload behavior.
PR: implement compaction v1 core (move-live-blocks to coalesce free space) with bounded work per tick; includes correctness assertions.
PR: add allocator slow-path tracing spans and timing histograms; links to dashboards and sampled tracing configuration.
PR: scheduler hook to run background compaction under decode-heavy steady state; adds compaction budget controls.
PR: eviction policy scaffolding (interfaces + default LRU-ish strategy) and integration point in memory-pressure handling.
PR: implement eviction candidate scoring with request priority + age; adds tests and notes about fairness/starvation.
PR: fix race discovered in compaction with concurrent stream cancellations; adds stress test reproducer.
PR: add compaction telemetry: bytes moved, time spent, and ‘compaction aborted’ reasons; ensures low-cardinality labels.
PR: update runtime config docs and comments in-code describing compaction/eviction knobs; includes migration notes.
PR: add “panic mode” fallback—force aggressive eviction and throttle when allocator fails; includes SRE-friendly log messages.
PR: refactor KV block binning strategy to reduce fragmentation for common sequence-length buckets.
PR: add long-running soak test harness for KV fragmentation; runs in CI nightly with artifact upload.
PR: ensure compaction is scheduling-aware (avoid compaction during prefill spikes); adds heuristics and tunables.
PR: tighten CI perf gate thresholds and add regression detection for p99 under burst scenario.
PR: add benchmark scenario “mixed-length burst + long-run fragmentation” with output schema for fragmentation metrics.
PR: add notebook/script updates for comparing before/after compaction runs; standardizes plots and summary tables.
PR: add canary job that runs 6-hour soak on staging GPUs; fails on fragmentation slope and p99 jitter thresholds.
PR: tune canary alerting and rerun logic to reduce flakiness; adds annotation when hardware SKU changes.
PR: add Grafana dashboard JSON and alert rules for KV cache fragmentation and compaction time; includes runbook links.
PR: add end-to-end test for eviction correctness (no wrong-token outputs) under forced memory pressure.
PR: optimize compaction memcpy path / stream usage to reduce GPU stall; includes microbench numbers and reviewer feedback.
PR: add “compaction budget exceeded” logging + metrics; ensures compaction work is bounded to avoid latency spikes.
PR: fix metric cardinality issue (per-request labels) caught in review; replaces with bucketed labels.
PR: staging rollout config enabling compaction for 5% traffic; includes verification checklist and rollback steps.
PR: add runtime release note entry + config reference updates; ties to runtime-1.21.
PR: improve allocator debug dumps for oncall (compact summary of free lists and largest blocks).
PR: hotfix to reduce compaction trigger aggressiveness after staging p95 regression; adds hysteresis and cooldown.
PR: add compatibility handling for older GPU SKUs where compaction path performs worse; auto-disable with warning.
PR: integrate SRE runbook link into alert annotations and error messages for faster incident response.
PR: implement eviction “protect streaming sessions” rule to avoid user-visible stream interruptions; includes tests.
PR: add soak-test report upload to Drive/GCS artifact store; includes summary comment posted by CI bot.
PR: finalize production rollout defaults (still flag-gated) and add config migration notes for Dedicated/Private.
PR: LTS backport (cherry-picks critical metrics + safe compaction fixes) with reduced scope; includes release-manager approval.
PR: cleanup + tech debt follow-up: remove old allocator debug code paths and update internal docs links.

Customer ticket: intermittent timeouts during peak hours on Dedicated; investigation notes point to KV churn and memory-pressure slow-paths.
Customer ticket: asks for mitigation guidance and timeline; support shares workaround toggles and upcoming compaction rollout.

Internal ticket: request to backport safe metrics + compaction hotfix to LTS branch for enterprise deployments.

Email thread: SRE follow-ups and action item tracking; links to Confluence incident review and runbook updates.

Fireflies transcript: technical deep dive with enterprise prospect on tail latency; discusses KV cache fragmentation symptoms, upcoming compaction work, and benchmark plan.
Fireflies transcript: customer success check-in after latency incident; recap of mitigations, rollout plan, and success criteria for improvement.
